kind: gen_input (Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x input decks, five-run pipeline)
provenance: rubric constants and structure references from 3_reproduction/L1/ (as-run decks 01-05 and the relaxed-geometry filled decks 02/04); see ../../3_reproduction/L1/index.md and result.json. The graded pipeline is the five pw.x runs relax, scf, bands, scf_sc, bands_sc.

magnetization.note: AFM-A: at least two Mn sublattice species with opposite-sign, nonzero starting magnetization; Mn sites uniform-signed within each c-plane and alternating plane to plane; net Mn magnetization ~0.

occupations.note: gapped magnetic semiconductor: fixed occupations (our run used smearing), tetrahedra, or smearing narrow relative to the ~0.75 eV gap. Broad metal-style smearing fails. Ungraded on the band runs (density not recomputed there).

structure_match.note: custom lenient match on base elements (Mn sublattice labels folded to Mn): per-axis cell length within 2%, angles within 1 deg, then a rigid-translation nearest-same-element site scan within 0.15 A. Rejects wrong phase, wrong cell size, wrong species. 2% spans both the staged start cell (a=4.148) and our relaxed cell (a=4.2066), which is why a competent relax deck carrying either cell passes.

kpath.note: primitive bands path must cover connected Gamma-M-K-Gamma-A-L segments with both endpoints and at least one actual interior point per segment, allowing reverse traversal, supported star representatives and extra paths, and contain two literal Gamma-to-L arms reaching their respective L endpoints whose splitting-sign parities differ (parity = 60-degree azimuthal sector index XOR (k_z < 0); an arm within nodal_margin_deg of a 60-degree-multiple azimuth lies in a spin-degenerate mirror plane and is rejected). This is the inequivalent L, L' requirement: it rejects L' = -L, a C3-equivalent partner (same parity), and a nodal-direction endpoint such as literal (1/2, 1/2, 1/2). No independent total-point floor; explicit-list integration weights do not count as samples. Supercell bands must sample the folded L-Gamma-L' line: each supercell k-point g is mapped to a half-preimage f = (g+m)/2 (m in {0,1}^3) lying on one of the six canonical hexagonal Gamma-to-L directions (x k_z sign); on a folded leg the point carries both primitive preimages s and 1-s, so reach = max over points of min(s, 1-s) >= sc_arm_sigma_reach, i.e. the leg reaches the supercell zone boundary. Two legs of differing splitting-sign parity, each with >= sc_arm_min_points points, are required (the on-line preimages are an arm and its inversion image, which share parity, so folded-leg parity is well defined). No independent total-point floor. Points on other folded segments of the primitive path are ignored.
kpath.L_arm_note: primitive arm detector: literal Gamma-to-endpoint directions enumerated in code as (i/2, j/2, +-1/2), i,j in {-1,0,1}, (i,j) != (0,0) (16 directions: the twelve antinodal M/L azimuths x k_z sign, plus the four 60-degree nodal directions, which are detected and then rejected by the parity classifier). Accepts crystal, crystal_b (expanded with QE band-path semantics), tpiba and tpiba_b (converted through the deck's own cell). The primitive endpoint test uses literal coordinates and the existing vertex tolerance. Integration decks accept automatic or complete equal-positive-weight uniform crystal/tpiba meshes with the existing per-axis floors and centering.
kpath.sc_note: supercell coverage rule: folded-L legs detected as half-preimages of the six canonical hexagonal L directions (x k_z sign); reach = max min(s,1-s) >= sc_arm_sigma_reach (the leg folds back at the supercell zone boundary), >= sc_arm_min_points points per leg, two qualifying legs of differing splitting-sign parity; points on other folded segments of the primitive path are allowed
kpath.count_policy: Required named nodal segments, endpoints, actual interior samples, two inequivalent arms, and existing arm_min_points=3/sc_arm_min_points=10 plus reach/parity tests remain. These retained local coverage guards are not claimed as scientifically minimal convergence bounds. Redundant global100/60 point floors removed; no replacement count inferred from an archived answer.

cross_deck.note: Within each supplied SCF-to-bands pair, effective prefix is the same logical dataset identifier. Ordered species/type and physical spin-model compatibility are checked separately. Output directories, working-directory placement and runtime-file existence are not scored. Relaxation feeds geometry and is not a saved-data pair; prefixes across different pairs are unconstrained.

score: 1 only if all five decks pass every REQUIRED check (calculation, nspin=2, AFM-A sublattice encoding, Mn-3d Hubbard U in band, UPF identity, species counts, ecutwfc floor, ecutrho >= 4x, conv_thr upper bound on the three self-consistent runs, structure match, per-label mesh/path/nbnd, occupations on the self-consistent runs) and both scf->bands chains are prefix (runtime directories ungraded)-consistent. Binary all-primary-pass; any single failure scores 0.

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.

reference_submission_note: Grading reference decks use the automatic-kmesh-v1 lower bound. Some K_POINTS cards were updated for acceptance; original reproduction inputs and computed outputs remain unchanged. These revised decks are not claimed to be executed reproduction runs.
runtime_directory_policy: Output directories, working-directory placement and directory equivalence are not scored. Required submitted files and logical file identities remain part of the input task. User decision 2026-09-17.

saved_afm_handoff.rule: AFM starting seeds remain required on relaxation and SCF producers. Collinear bands inherit the supplied SCF spin density: do not score repeated bands starting_magnetization. Require nspin=2, compatible ordered species labels/type indices and UPF identities; test consumer basal-plane encoding with producer seeds. Existing Hubbard, species counts and structure rules remain. No runtime files or directory settings are scored.
saved_afm_handoff.source: QE 7.5 PW/src/input.f90, potinit.f90 and io_rho_xml.f90; documented source trace in docs/review/grader_semantics_20260917/physics/followup.md. This is the submitted collinear SCF->bands route, not a general noncollinear waiver.
